question: Should QQBot gateway messages fail closed at the proposed 1 MiB ceiling, or should this channel use a higher ceiling such as 16 MiB?
rationale: The ws mechanism is correct, but the provider documentation cited by the PR does not establish a maximum legitimate QQ event size; choosing the permanent fail-closed boundary is a compatibility and message-delivery decision for the QQBot owner.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Accept the tighter resource boundary based on the JSON-only gateway shape and successful 900 KiB loopback proof, then resolve the conflict while preserving handshakeTimeout.

options.title: Use a higher ceiling
options.body: Choose a more permissive bound such as 16 MiB to reduce rare-event compatibility risk while still shrinking the ws default substantially.

options.title: Request production-size evidence
options.body: Pause until representative QQ gateway traffic or an authoritative provider limit establishes a defensible ceiling.

recommendation.title: Approve 1 MiB
recommendation.body: Accept the tighter resource boundary based on the JSON-only gateway shape and successful 900 KiB loopback proof, then resolve the conflict while preserving handshakeTimeout.

likelyOwner.reason: The major QQBot gateway architecture work makes this contributor the strongest available history-based routing candidate for the channel-specific boundary decision.
